zh-TW.title: 子代理與工作分工
zh-TW.description: 子代理適合把能獨立完成的工作分開處理，再由主要任務整合結果。分工會增加模型與工具用量；若工作互相依賴、都要改同一段程式，平行處理反而可能產生衝突。

hero.alt: 實作順序示意圖，非產品介面截圖。

blocks.text: 子代理適合把能獨立完成的工作分開處理，再由主要任務整合結果。分工會增加模型與工具用量；若工作互相依賴、都要改同一段程式，平行處理反而可能產生衝突。
你會學到什麼
最後得到一份去重、經核對的結果，能追溯每項結論的證據；不是把子代理報告直接拼在一起。
預估操作時間: 15 分鐘
開始之前
先把目標拆成兩個唯讀檢查：一個檢查文字內容，一個檢查頁面結構。為每項指定輸入、範圍與交付格式，主要任務保留最後判斷。
逐步操作
1. 在支援的 Codex 介面明確要求使用子代理，交代每個子任務的邊界。不要只說『多找幾個人』而没有具体成果。
2. 第一個代理只讀 README 與文字，第二個只讀 HTML 結構。兩者都不要改檔；這能先練習如何整合證據，避免並行寫入。
3. 查看子代理的進度與結果。CLI 可依官方 /agent 操作切換檢查；其他介面使用其顯示的代理狀態，不假定所有入口相同。

spans.text: 4. 主代理核對每個發現的檔案、原因與影響，處理互相矛盾的結論，再決定是否需要修改。若未來要平行實作，先分離檔案責任或

blocks.caption: 28. 子代理與工作分工 — 實作順序示意圖，非產品介面截圖。 Bounded tasks → Subagents → Review

blocks.text: 練習需求

blocks.code: 請使用兩個子代理做唯讀檢查：A 檢查 README 與頁面文字一致性，B 檢查 HTML 結構。各回報檔案與證據，由主代理整合，不修改檔案。

blocks.text: 範例與驗證

rows: 先確認環境
先把目標拆成兩個唯讀檢查：一個檢查文字內容，一個檢查頁面結構。為每項指定輸入、範圍與交付格式，主要任務保留最後判斷。
完成一個操作
主代理核對每個發現的檔案、原因與影響，處理互相矛盾的結論，再決定是否需要修改。若未來要平行實作，先分離檔案責任或 worktree。
檢查真實結果
最後得到一份去重、經核對的結果，能追溯每項結論的證據；不是把子代理報告直接拼在一起。

blocks.text: 完成結果
最後得到一份去重、經核對的結果，能追溯每項結論的證據；不是把子代理報告直接拼在一起。
常見問題
代理數量多不保證更快。當結果依賴另一項未完成工作，改成順序執行；發現兩者碰同一檔案時先停止衝突的修改。

zh-CN.description: 子代理适合把能独立完成的工作分开处理，再由主要任务整合结果。分工会增加模型与工具用量；若工作互相依赖、都要改同一段程式，平行处理反而可能产生冲突。

en.title: Subagents and task delegation
en.description: Subagents suit independent work that can be reviewed and combined by the main task. They consume additional model and tool usage. Parallel tasks with mutual dependencies or overlapping edits can create more conflict than speed.

hero.alt: Workflow illustration, not a product screenshot.

blocks.text: Subagents suit independent work that can be reviewed and combined by the main task. They consume additional model and tool usage. Parallel tasks with mutual dependencies or overlapping edits can create more conflict than speed.
What you will learn
The final report is checked, deduplicated and traceable to evidence rather than a concatenation of subagent messages.
Estimated practice time: 15 min
Before you start
Split the exercise into two read-only checks: content consistency and HTML structure. Give each input, boundaries and an output format, retaining final judgment in the main task.
Step by step
1. Explicitly request subagents in a supported Codex client and define concrete deliverables rather than merely asking for more agents.
2. Assign one agent README/text consistency and another HTML structure. For the first exercise, prohibit edits so you can practice evidence integration without concurrent writes.
3. Inspect activity and results. CLI provides documented /agent controls; other clients expose their own activity surfaces.

spans.text: 4. The main agent checks files, reasons and impacts, resolves conflicting conclusions and decides on justified fixes. For parallel implementation later, separate file ownership or use

blocks.alt: 28. Subagents and task delegation — Workflow illustration, not a product screenshot. Bounded tasks → Subagents → Review
blocks.caption: 28. Subagents and task delegation — Workflow illustration, not a product screenshot. Bounded tasks → Subagents → Review

blocks.text: Practice request

blocks.code: Use two read-only subagents: A checks README against page wording; B checks HTML structure. Each reports files and evidence. The main agent integrates findings without editing files.

blocks.text: Example and verification

rows: Confirm the environment
Split the exercise into two read-only checks: content consistency and HTML structure. Give each input, boundaries and an output format, retaining final judgment in the main task.
Complete one action
The main agent checks files, reasons and impacts, resolves conflicting conclusions and decides on justified fixes. For parallel implementation later, separate file ownership or use worktrees.
Inspect the actual result
The final report is checked, deduplicated and traceable to evidence rather than a concatenation of subagent messages.

blocks.text: Expected result
The final report is checked, deduplicated and traceable to evidence rather than a concatenation of subagent messages.
Troubleshooting
More agents do not guarantee speed. Sequence dependent tasks and stop conflicting edits when two agents touch the same files.

blocks.text: サブエージェントは独立した調査を分担し、主担当が統合する仕組みです。利用量が増え、依存や編集の重複があると競合します。
学べること

練習時間の目安: 15 分
始める前に
文章の整合性と HTML 構造の二つの読み取り調査に分けます。
操作手順
1. サブエージェントの利用と、それぞれの入力、範囲、成果を明示します。
2. 一方は README と文章、他方は構造だけを読み、編集を禁止します。
3. 進捗と結果を確認します。CLI は /agent、他の画面は対応する操作を使います。
